_about: Central env list (CONTRACT.md section 7). hipaa = the environment holds HIPAA client records (ruled 10/6/26, Dylan: Recovery ONLY; the rest are fine). Its client-identifying information is never PERSISTED outside Dataverse: job files and the store may not sit in a git-tracked folder. The shared log is a Dataverse table, so it carries names in full; printed output is not redacted (dropped 10/7/26, Dylan). closed_year = the closed-fiscal-year guard (DESIGN.md 8d): table -> book-date column; a gift or soft credit in a closed FY is never created, edited or deactivated (an FY locks Dec 1 after it ends; Dylan 9/24 + 9/29/26). Gifts and soft credits are both msnfp_transaction rows.
